svg.title: Tower Base — Warden seal & bell
svg.desc: Enter through the sealed base door, circle the bell counterweight and climb past maintenance balconies. A long return rope skips the ascent. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Enter through the sealed base door, circle the bell counterweight and climb past
